requires_external_validation.scope: Qualify the actual flipped/capped isotope pair with measured optical tensors,withheld-frequency/momentum tests,static/elastic/contact/strain and transfer controls. Then measure a preregistered dark target response at a full systematic and independent-pair cost budget against established same-target methods.
